task_analysis.description: Optimizing the MoE (Mixture of Experts) dispatch and quantization logic for DeepEP. The task involves reordering operations (quantization vs. dispatch) based on the quantization configuration to minimize overhead and ensure efficient kernel execution.

library_failure.failure_reason: The agent failed to interact with the PyTorch-based MoE implementation logic as requested.

bottleneck_target.discussion: The human expert identified a logic flaw where the code was checking for per-token quantization instead of block quantization to decide the execution path. The agent did not provide any code changes, thus failing to target any bottleneck.

optimization_techniques.discussion: The human patch optimizes the control flow to ensure that quantization happens at the most efficient stage of the pipeline (Dispatch and Quant vs Quant and Dispatch) based on the specific hardware/kernel capabilities. The agent used no techniques.

approach_comparison.discussion: The agent provided no solution. The human solution correctly identifies that DeepEP kernels support block-quantized activation scales and adjusts the conditional logic to utilize the correct quantization path.

speedup_likelihood.discussion: Since no changes were made by the agent, there is zero performance improvement. The human patch likely yields significant speedups in MoE layers using block quantization by avoiding incorrect fallback paths or inefficient dispatching.
